variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: SAC is statically typed and resembles C syntax, but enforces single-assignment in its core representation.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Scalar types are directly inherited from C.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Standard C operators are used, operating on scalars as well as being automatically lifted to array dimensions.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: SAC supports C-like conditionals. Variables assigned in branches must be consistent across branches.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: While standard for-loops exist, With-loops are fundamental in SAC for expressing parallel multi-dimensional array operations.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: C-style while loops are supported, though inherently sequential.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions can be overloaded by array rank and shape. Operations extend natively to arrays.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays are first-class, pure functional citizens in SAC. Shape is tracked as part of the type system.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Being an array-processing language, SAC focuses purely on multi-dimensional numeric data rather than maps/hash tables.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: SAC avoids dynamic exceptions. Error management is done via return values or aborting execution on fatal conditions.

comments.title: Comments & Headers
comments.code:
# Comment in SAC
# Multi-line comments or docstrings
# are documented here
comments.notes: SAC uses # or language-specific delimiters (% in MATLAB, ! in Fortran) for comments.

numbers.title: Vectors, Matrices & Numbers
numbers.notes: SAC is optimized for vector and matrix calculations with high-precision numerical representations.

booleans.title: Logical Vectors & Booleans
booleans.code:
is_valid = TRUE
flags = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)
booleans.notes: SAC provides boolean types with support for element-wise vector logic operations.

type_casting.title: Type Coercion & Casting
type_casting.notes: SAC converts data between numeric, character, factor, and logical representations.

strings.title: Strings & Character Vectors
strings.notes: SAC treats strings as atomic character scalars or vector arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: SAC formats numerical output with sprintf formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Switches
pattern_matching.notes: SAC executes branch logic via switch, ifelse, or conditional filtering.

range.title: Sequences & Indexing
range.notes: SAC indexes matrices and vectors using 1-based indexing and sequence generators.

iterators.title: Vectorized Apply & Iteration
iterators.notes: SAC emphasizes vectorized functional processing (apply, map) over explicit loops.

oop_classes.title: Object Systems & S3/S4
oop_classes.code:
# Object systems in SAC
obj = list(name = "Model", score = 0.95)
class(obj) = "metric"
oop_classes.notes: SAC uses class dispatch systems (S3/S4 in R, multiple dispatch in Julia) for data modeling.

lists.title: DataFrames & Lists
lists.notes: SAC stores heterogeneous columnar records in data frames and lists.

tuples.title: Pairs & Records
tuples.notes: SAC uses named vectors or lightweight structures for data records.

sets.title: Set Operations
sets.notes: SAC provides native mathematical set functions (union, intersect, setdiff).

modules_import.title: Libraries & Packages
modules_import.notes: SAC loads package namespaces using library or import declarations.
